verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for an auth framework, but the evidence pack never documents a hook, action, or rule system that fires actions on auth events. The nearest items are related but different features: per-path rate-limit rules, a default auto sign-in after signup, and an activity feed on the homepage. None of these is a user-defined event-to-action rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
